definitions.ask: Add a required real-Obsidian takeover check proving ownership survives an unrelated vault write?
definitions.why: the matrix only checks ownership right after open, which is why this regression shipped

choices.label: The takeover matrix gains one required survival check, run green on athena before landing
Unit and source-guard tests only; the real-app matrix keeps checking acquisition alone

definitions.ask: After landing, refresh the MacBook's vault copy with `ssh mac 'bob plugins sync -p bob-ledger-tools'`?
definitions.why: the Mac's plugin copy refreshes only manually, and the Mac is where the bug shows

choices.label: The fix reaches the Mac, where the bug was seen, without waiting for a manual sync
Only athena is deployed; Bryan syncs the Mac himself
